evals.prompt: I need to run the remote Slurm job described in /workspace/input/remote-mfa/job_spec.json on our cluster over SSH. The internal-env-info skill isn't installed, so use the fields in the job spec. First step is getting a working SSH connection: what do you do? This sandbox has no network route to the cluster, so don't open any SSH connection; give me the exact instructions and commands.
evals.expected_output: Because the job spec sets mfa_style: true, go straight to the MFA path: if no ControlMaster is live, ask the user to run `ssh -fNM -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/ssh-trtllm-%r@%h:%p -o ControlPersist=24h jdoe@login.example.com` in their own terminal and complete the MFA prompt, then verify with `ssh -o ControlPath=/tmp/ssh-trtllm-%r@%h:%p -O check jdoe@login.example.com` and reuse that ControlPath for all later ssh/scp commands.
assertions: Chooses the MFA path because the job spec has `mfa_style: true`, instead of probing a direct connection and reacting to the error.
Asks the user to run `ssh -fNM -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/ssh-trtllm-%r@%h:%p -o ControlPersist=24h jdoe@login.example.com` in their own terminal and complete MFA there.
Verifies the master afterwards with `-O check` against the `/tmp/ssh-trtllm-%r@%h:%p` ControlPath before continuing.
States that subsequent ssh/scp commands reuse the socket via `-o ControlPath=/tmp/ssh-trtllm-%r@%h:%p`.
Does not try to complete MFA on the user's behalf (no collecting the password or PIN, no sshpass/expect) and opens no SSH connection from the sandbox.

evals.prompt: Before submitting the remote job in /workspace/input/remote-sync/job_spec.json, my local edits need to reach the cluster checkout. My local repo state is in /workspace/input/remote-sync/git_status.txt; the remote clone already exists at the job spec's remote_repo_path, and the SSH ControlMaster is already up. Give me the exact command sequence that gets both my modified tracked files and my new untracked files onto the cluster. This sandbox has no repo and no network, so don't run git push or ssh here.
evals.expected_output: Two-mechanism sync: create temp branch `jdoe_llama3_8b_<YYYYmmddHHMMSS>`, `git add -u`, `git commit --allow-empty`, and push it to origin; on the remote, stash leftovers, `git fetch origin --prune`, `git checkout -B <temp> origin/<temp>`, and `rm -rf cpp/ && git checkout HEAD -- cpp/`; ship the two untracked files with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tar ... | ssh ... "tar -C <remote_repo_path> -xf -"`; then restore feature/fp8-kv locally and delete the temp branch locally and on origin.
assertions: Creates a temporary branch named `jdoe_llama3_8b_<timestamp>` and commits tracked edits with `git add -u` (not `git add -A` or `git add .`) and `git commit --allow-empty`.
Pushes the temp branch to origin and, on the remote, runs `git fetch origin --prune` and `git checkout -B <temp> origin/<temp>` rather than checking out `feature/fp8-kv`.
Re-materializes cpp/ on the remote with `rm -rf cpp/ && git checkout HEAD -- cpp/` after the checkout.
Transfers the untracked files via `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` piped through tar over SSH, not rsync, sshfs, or a commit.
Afterwards checks out feature/fp8-kv locally and deletes the temp branch both locally and on origin.
Does not run git push or ssh from the sandbox.

Submits build.slurm with sbatch using `--job-name=team_llm-trtllm.build`, `--time=02:00:00`, one node/one task, and `--gpus-per-node=4` (gpus_per_node is set).

Reduces the pending job's walltime in place with `scontrol update JobId=7712345 TimeLimit=01:00:00` (30 minutes of work rounded up to the next hour) rather than cancelling and resubmitting.
